evidence.summary: Sensor snapshot for U025 (cycle 190) shows position_error_um increased 14.3% (z=1.4) while spindle vibration remains normal; coolant pressure slightly up, inlet/outlet pressures down modestly.
RUL estimate indicates 62.9 cycles remaining, policy band above_50_monitor, suggesting no immediate failure but monitoring required.
SOP-E-302 describes slow, steady increase in position error as a symptom of axis calibration drift.
SOP-E-301 notes that intermittent spikes indicate sensor fault, whereas a steady rise points to calibration drift.
Recent fleet tickets (e.g., T1049, T1014) document calibration drift symptoms with similar position error trends and actions of running axis calibration.

report.summary: U025 exhibited a 14% increase in position_error_um at cycle 190, while other sensors remain within normal ranges. The pattern matches the slow, steady position error rise described in SOP-E-302 for calibration drift, and similar fleet incidents were resolved by axis calibration. RUL remains healthy, so a preventive axis calibration is recommended to correct drift before it impacts performance.

hits.title: Axis calibration drift
hits.text: Position error increasing slowly and steadily over many cycles, often after a temperature change; parts drifting toward tolerance limits; no spikes.

hits.title: Position sensor fault: intermittent position error
hits.text: Position error shows sudden spikes well above 10 um that appear and disappear between cycles; other sensors normal; no vibration or temperature change.

hits.title: Position sensor fault: intermittent position error
hits.text: Intermittent spikes without a mechanical signature point to the linear scale reader head, encoder cable or connector. A slow steady increase is calibration drift instead (see SOP-E-302).
